scope: Matched four-thread CPU deployment on precomputed raw embeddings. All 23 outer evaluations and 13 penalties, at most 128 deterministically hash-selected test queries per evaluation. Identical queries and batch sizes for all methods; full source sets. No encoder forward pass, training, validation, or new selection. Hardware recorded per paired fold. Not a GPU deployment benchmark or from-scratch encoder comparison.
phases: Separate source/checkpoint/transform setup, query preprocessing, and prediction. kNN retrieval and reward/cost means reused across penalties; per-penalty utility/choice measured separately. NVIDIA five-network inference, averaging and choice measured per penalty. Shared L21 controls measured once and reuse identified. Warmup once, three raw elapsed measurements retained; cache-warm CPU latency.
numerical_audit: Reconstruct saved PCA features and NVIDIA predictions using predeclared tolerances; record all choice differences. kNN uses original float32 cosine and stable full sorting, checks distinct source-only neighbours and exact reward/cost means; record all differences from historical predictions and across batches without suppressing outcomes.
